# Succession Plan 2025

Three critical leadership roles identified as at-risk in the Q1 review:

1. Head of Engineering — no internal successor ready; external search initiated
2. VP of Sales — two internal candidates at 60% readiness; expected 12 months to ready
3. Chief Legal Officer — planned retirement Q3 2026; succession programme underway

The succession planning process follows a 9-box grid methodology.
Readiness is rated on a 0–100% scale updated quarterly.

Next review date: 2025-06-30
